events.title: Beyond listed stocks: MSEI rallies 125%, Zepto retreats 48%; here’s how other pre-IPO names fared
events.summary: The unlisted-share market has seen wide price swings in 2026, with MSEI more than doubling its indicative value, while Zepto has nearly halved. According to Unlisted Arena data, Goodluck Defence & Aerospace, PPFAS, API Holdings and Prisma Global AI were among the other notable gainers, while NCDEX, OYO, GFCL EV Products and Garuda Aerospace also declined.

events.title: Amazon plans to invest  ₹25,000 crore in India's quick-commerce sector, but can it catch up to Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy?
events.summary: Amazon plans to invest $3 billion in its India quick-commerce business by 2030, aiming to increase its market presence. Currently, Amazon holds a 6.2% market share, competing against rivals like Swiggy and Blinkit, which dominate with 77% of the sector.

events.title: AssetGro Fintech to file DRHP with Sebi for Rs 2,000-2,500 cr IPO
events.summary: AssetGro Fintech is gearing up to file its draft IPO documents with Sebi by the end of September. With expectations to raise between ₹2,000 and ₹2,500 crore, the IPO will feature a fresh issue of around ₹800 crore. The remainder will consist of an offer for sale by current shareholders. Emirates NBD Capital has been designated as the lead manager for this endeavor.
